text.p: AIK Stockholm of Sweden and Spain's Barcelona drew 1-1 (halftime 0-1) in their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter final second leg match on Thursday.

AIK: 1-Magnus Hedman, 3-Per Millqvist, 4-Ola Andersson, 5-Mikael Brundin, 9-Pascal Simpson, 10-Johan Mjallby, 26-Gary Sundgren, 27-Nebojsa Novakovic, 14-Thomas Lagerlof (6-Mattias Johansson 49), 17-Pierre Gallo (24-Patrick Fredholm 88), 15-Cesar Pacha (13-Dick Lidman 68).

Barcelona: 1-Vitor Baia, 27-Fernando Couto, 20-Miguel Angel Nadal, 2-Albert Ferrer, 12-Sergi Barjuan, 4-Josep Guardiola (18-Guillermo Amor 68), 5-Gheorghe Popescu, 23-Ivan de la Pena, 7-Luis Figo (10-Giovanni Silva de Olivira 63), 9-Ronaldo (19-Juan Antonio Pizzi 75), 8-Hristo Stoitchkov.
